credentials.title: Connect your Brain.fm account
credentials.description: Enter your Brain.fm email and password.
Optional: If login fails due to Cloudflare, open brain.fm in your browser,
open DevTools → Application → Cookies → api.brain.fm, and copy the __cf_bm value.

errors.rate_limited: Wait a few minutes and try again. If this keeps happening,
get the __cf_bm cookie from your browser.
